required_fields.capture_utc: UTC capture instant supplied by observer or UNKNOWN
required_fields.source_locator: private locator or public approved URI; never secrets
required_fields.source_sha256: 64-character lowercase hex or null with UNKNOWN state
required_fields.message_count: nonnegative integer only with populated message list and declared population, else null
required_fields.artifact_refs: array of records with id, media_type, bytes, sha256, custody, access_class, state
required_fields.evidence: list of source SHA/run ID/attempt/observation identities; optional field values must remain null when unknown

rules: Never infer full-chat completeness from visible prompts, reconstructed summaries, screenshots or GitHub records
Never make USER_DECLARED equal to provider-attested completeness
Never publish raw exports, private file names, secrets, access tokens or private asset URLs in a public branch
For non-UNKNOWN source_sha256 require exact 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and verified bytes
On stale branch/run or missing evidence set state STALE/UNKNOWN and preserve historic result
Sidecar remains optional: legacy V1 and ABACUS V2 outputs unchanged; unknown fields default UNKNOWN, not 0 or empty lists
PDF reading copy is a rendering derivative, not verbatim chat or proof of original message IDs

verification_cases.input: unsupported full transcript claim, no authorized export
reconstructed user prompt list presented as provider complete
private raw transcript in public metadata
